title: Word Search
summary: Return whether the word can be read along a path of cells.

contractDetails.constraints: A rectangular 1–6 by 1–6 board of English letters. Word length is 1–15 and uses only English letters.

statement: Return whether the word can be read along a path of cells. Consecutive cells must share a side and each cell can be used at most once in that path. Letter comparisons are case-sensitive. Leave the board unchanged when returning.

examples.explanation: The path follows the four sides of the square.
Matching the last A would reuse the first cell.
The second cell is the uppercase match.

constraints: A rectangular 1–6 by 1–6 board of English letters. Word length is 1–15 and uses only English letters.
hints: Conceptual: A matching letter is useful only if the rest of the path can continue from it.
Directional: Try each starting cell and track cells in the current path.
Implementation: Check bounds, the next character, and visited status. Undo any temporary mark when returning, even after a successful match.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn·4ᴸ) worst-case time and O(mn+L) auxiliary space with separate marks and recursion, where L is word length.
